novelty_basis: Standard product construction (varieties are closed under direct products); the anchored reformulation answers the lab's question whether a spectrum can be the primes.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C06.md Theorem 8); consistent with every spectrum observed in EXP-C06-02..04; awaiting independent skeptic review
statement: For every set of laws, if anchored models of coprime sizes N and M exist, then an anchored model of size NM exists (transport the direct product along the Chinese remainder isomorphism, which maps x + 1 to (x + 1, x + 1)). In particular no law has the set of primes as its anchored spectrum.
title: Anchored spectra are closed under coprime products
